Coast | Platform Engineer (Security), DevSecOps Engineer & Full-stack Product Engineer| Hybrid | NYC

Coast is re-imagining the trillion-dollar U.S. B2B card payments infrastructure, with a focus on the country’s 500,000 commercial fleets, 40 million commercial vehicles, and many million commercial drivers. Coast's mission is to deliver modern digital experiences, affordable and transparent financial services products at a transformational scale, and to improve working lives in one of the country’s biggest industry sectors.

Coast is competing and winning with software, and we are building a world-class engineering team. We are looking for a Platform Engineer (Security)/DevSecOps Engineer - first of it's kind at Coast, with high ownership, impact, visibility. We are also looking for full-stack product engineers across mid to senior levels.

If interested, please apply:

Product Engineer: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/coast/jobs/4000170004 Base: $160,000 - 215,000 + equity + benefits + equity and fun perks!

DevSecOps/Platform Engineer/Security Engineer: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/coast/jobs/5816914004 Base: $160,000 - $180,000 + equity + benefits + equity and fun perks!
